info.title: Corporate Fleet Management - Temporal Conflicts API
info.description: Deterministic RESTful API for driver, vehicle, and trip scheduling with temporal conflict verification.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no input or authorization requirement.
The system shall expose GET /drivers as an admin-only endpoint accepting optional filters.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /drivers as an admin-only endpoint creating unique driver.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /trips restricting standard users to requester-owned trips.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /trips validating driver and vehicle non-overlap before creating PLANNED trip.

409.description: Driver or vehicle temporal conflict or inactive

get.description: The system shall expose GET /trips/{trip_id} returning trip only to requester or admin.

patch.description: The system shall expose PATCH /trips/{trip_id} permitting changes only to PLANNED trips without conflicts.

409.description: Trip not PLANNED or conflict detected

post.description: The system shall expose POST /trips/{trip_id}/start moving trip to IN_PROGRESS and vehicle to ASSIGNED.

409.description: Trip not PLANNED, timestamp invalid, or vehicle not AVAILABLE

post.description: The system shall expose POST /trips/{trip_id}/complete moving trip to COMPLETED and vehicle to AVAILABLE.

409.description: Trip not IN_PROGRESS or invalid actual_end

post.description: The system shall expose POST /trips/{trip_id}/cancel retaining immutable cancellation history.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /drivers/{driver_id}/trip-conflicts returning active overlapping trips.
The system shall expose GET /vehicles/{vehicle_id}/trip-conflicts returning active overlapping trips.
